artboards.title: Icon Set Spec — 10 engine icons, nav icons, module icons, construction rules, label-pairing rule

annotations.text: Prompt 50 — Icon set specification. 24dp grid, 2dp stroke, round cap/join, 2dp corner radius. 10 AI Engine brand icons (confirmed PNG assets). 5 nav icons. 30+ module and action icons. Label-pairing rule per UI-UX §194: icons never stand alone where ambiguous.
